products.title: Dell Pro 5 Series 14" Business Laptop
products.description: The Dell Pro 5 Series 14" Business Laptop is a professional-grade computer featuring an Intel Core Ultra 5 335 vPro processor with 8 cores and a built-in NPU for AI tasks. It is equipped with 16GB of DDR5 RAM and a 512GB SSD for fast storage and performance. The device boasts a 14-inch WUXGA (1920 x 1200) non-touch display with 400 nits brightness, anti-glare coating, and low power consumption. Additional features include an FHD RGB + IR camera with presence detection and a shutter for security, a Mini-LED backlit keyboard, and Windows 11 Pro, making it a Copilot+ PC.

products.title: ExpertBook B1 14” Business Laptop
products.description: The ASUS ExpertBook B1 (B1403CVA-XS54) is a professional 14-inch business laptop designed for productivity and durability. It features an Intel Core i5-1335U processor, 16GB of DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe 4.0 SSD for fast performance. The device is equipped with a 14-inch FHD anti-glare display, a backlit chiclet keyboard, and a wide array of I/O ports including USB-C with power delivery. Built to withstand rigorous use, it meets the US MIL-STD 810H military-grade standard and comes in a professional Gentle Grey finish.

products.title: ExpertBook B5 14” Business Laptop
products.description: The ASUS ExpertBook B5 (B5405) is an ultralight, AI-ready business laptop designed for professionals. It is powered by the Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 Processor 255H with a dedicated NPU for AI task processing and Intel® Arc™ Graphics. This 14-inch laptop features a WQXGA (2560 x 1600) anti-glare display with a 144Hz refresh rate, 16GB of high-speed DDR5 RAM, and a 512GB PCIe® 4.0 SSD. Designed for durability and security, it meets the MIL-STD 810H US military standard and includes enterprise-grade security features like a fingerprint sensor, TPM 2.0, and a webcam privacy shield. Connectivity is comprehensive with Thunderbolt™ 4, HDMI 2.1, WiFi 7, and more.
